message.content:
This black-and-white editorial cover features a close-up, high-contrast portrait of a person's face from the forehead to the chin. The individual's skin is deeply lined and textured with wrinkles and pores. Their right hand is positioned in the foreground, with fingers curled towards the mouth and the thumb resting near the lower lip. The person’s gaze is directed slightly upward and to the left of the frame. 

Large, bold red text reading "TEMPO" spans the top section. Above this, white text reads "PELURU HAMPA NYANYIAN SETYA" and "PERANG GARAM KABINET JOKOWI". Centered on the right side is a red rectangular box containing the white text "GATOT NURMANTYO:". Below this, large white block letters state "SAYA BUKAN PELACUR POLITIK". Further down, smaller white text says "Bersiap maju dalam pemilihan presiden 2019, mantan Panglima TNI lincah mencari dukungan. Blakblakan tentang hubungannya dengan kelompok 212 dan Tomy Winata." At the bottom left, white text indicates "2-8 APRIL 2018" and "RP 45.000", positioned above a barcode. A thin red border frames the left and right edges.
